## Change

Describe the user-visible outcome and any migration/rollback requirements.

## Validation

List executed checks and their evidence. Keep unfinished checks unchecked.

## Release to main only

Use a `release: <version>` title and open the PR from develop. Complete the following only after the exercises have actually passed:

- [ ] Production providers and target devices validated.
- [ ] Backup restore and rollback exercised.
- [ ] Public support, privacy and retention information finalized.
